channel.title: AI Threat Watch wire
channel.description: AI security headlines from vetted sources, refreshed every 30 minutes.

item.title: Faux doublon de paiement : photo truquée avec l'IA, remboursement en espèces... Quelle est cette arnaque qui a visé plusieurs restaurateurs du Tarn
item.description: ladepeche.fr: La Dépêche reports AI-doctored photos and a fake duplicate-payment ruse used to get cash refunds from Tarn restaurants.

item.title: Stolen AI access leaves companies with cloud bills of up to $1 million
item.description: Help Net Security: Google GTIG and Mandiant say criminals use stolen cloud access to run AI models, with victims billed over $100,000 in one day.

item.title: Saint-Sulpice-la-Pointe. Fausse preuve bancaire génére par l'IA : plusieurs restaurateurs tarnais victimes d'une escroquerie
item.description: letarnlibre.com: Several restaurateurs in the Tarn, France, were scammed with an AI-generated bank proof and doctored photos to obtain refunds.

item.title: Россия сообщила о первой кибератаке, совершенной с использованием искусственного интеллекта.
item.description: Vietnam.vn: Russia reports its first cyberattack carried out using artificial intelligence.

item.title: 因担忧遭黑客攻击……现代汽车突然禁止核心部门使用AI
item.description: 매일경제: Hyundai Motor reportedly suddenly banned core departments from using AI over fears of hacking.

item.title: В Британии прогнозируют всплеск кибератак с ИИ на инфраструктуру в ближайшие два года
item.description: Слово и Дело: UK authorities reportedly forecast a surge in AI-enabled cyberattacks on infrastructure over the next two years.

item.title: 央视曝光AI网恋诈骗 未婚妻全程由AI生成 刘先生被骗超18万元
item.description: 新浪财经_金融信息服务商: CCTV reports a man surnamed Liu lost over 180,000 yuan to an online romance scam where his fiancée was entirely AI-generated.

item.title: AI伪造悲惨画面骗善款 张念群吁捐款前先查证
item.description: e南洋: Zhang Nianqun urges people to verify appeals before donating after AI-forged tragic images were used to solicit funds.

item.title: 细思极恐！央视起底AI女友骗局：7天养号，半月骗走18万
item.description: 雷科技: CCTV exposes an AI 'girlfriend' romance scam in China that groomed victims for days before taking money.

item.title: La Russie signale sa première cyberattaque menée par une intelligence artificielle.
item.description: Vietnam.vn: Russia reports its first cyberattack carried out by AI, duplicating the earlier report of the Russian company hit.

item.title: Hackers Exploit DLL Sideloading in Signed OpenAI and Anthropic Binaries to Deploy YobaLoader Malware
item.description: GBHackers: Check Point details the Yoba campaign using DLL sideloading in signed OpenAI and Anthropic binaries to drop mining malware.

item.title: La Russie signale sa première cyberattaque entièrement menée par une intelligence artificielle.
item.description: Vietnam.vn: Russia reports a cyberattack on a company that was reportedly carried out entirely by AI.

item.title: Rusia informa de su primer ciberataque llevado a cabo mediante inteligencia artificial.
item.description: Vietnam.vn: Russia reports its first cyberattack carried out by AI, apparently the already-tracked attack on a Russian company.

item.title: A Survey on Agentic Security: Applications, Threats and Defenses
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: Survey covers 274 papers on agentic AI applications, threats and defenses.

item.title: JailbreakOPT: Iterative Jailbreak Prompt Optimization with Macro-Action
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: JailbreakOPT paper presents an iterative jailbreak prompt optimization method for LLMs.

item.title: GitInject: Real-World Prompt Injection Attacks in AI-Powered CI/CD Pipelines
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: GitInject studies prompt injection attacks on AI agents embedded in CI/CD pipelines.

item.title: RogueMerge: Robust and Unified Attacks against LLM Model Merging
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: RogueMerge paper presents attacks that embed malicious behavior via LLM model merging.

item.title: Clawdrain: Exploiting Tool-Calling Chains for Stealthy Token Exhaustion in OpenClaw Agents
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: Clawdrain paper shows malicious skills can cause stealthy token exhaustion in OpenClaw agents.

item.title: AuthRank: Scoring Source Credibility to Counter Poisoning in CTI LLM Pipelines
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: AuthRank scores source credibility to counter poisoning of LLM-based cyber threat intelligence pipelines.

item.title: AgentTypo: Adaptive Typographic Prompt Injection Attacks against Black-box Multimodal Agents
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: AgentTypo paper presents adaptive text-in-image prompt injection attacks on black-box multimodal agents.

item.title: Ranked but Not Stopped: Detecting Prompt-Injection Hijacks from Typed Decision Models' Output Probabilities
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: Paper detects prompt-injection hijacks of LLM classifiers from output probabilities.

item.title: Decision Models as Policy Gates for Coding Agents: Explicit Policy Boundaries Improve Detection and Reduce False Alarms
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: Study evaluates decision models as runtime policy gates to catch risky coding-agent actions.

item.title: MCP Tool Poisoning in Agentic AI Frameworks: A Cross-Framework Measurement Study
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: Measurement study of MCP tool poisoning across agentic AI frameworks.

item.title: IAMRAGBENCH: Benchmarking Authorization Expansions in LLM-Generated AWS IAM Policies under RAG Poisoning
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: IAMRAGBENCH benchmarks how RAG poisoning leads LLMs to generate over-permissive AWS IAM policies.

item.title: ATrust: Adaptive Trust Boundary Expansion for Securing LLM Agents
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: ATrust proposes adaptive trust boundary expansion to secure autonomous LLM agents.

item.title: The Customer Never Sees the Goal: Measuring and Detecting Vulnerability-Targeted Manipulation in LLM Assistants
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: Paper measures and detects operator-induced manipulation of vulnerable customers by LLM website assistants.

item.title: Where Does MCP Security End? A Three-Tier Mitigation Mapping Framework for the OWASP MCP Top 10
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: Paper maps mitigations for the OWASP MCP Top 10 into three tiers for Model Context Protocol security.

item.title: StateFence: Task-State Protection Against Evidence-Chain Contamination in Blue-Team LLM Agents
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: StateFence paper addresses indirect prompt injection contaminating evidence chains in blue-team LLM agents in SOCs.

item.title: Detect, Repair and Audit: A Hierarchical Multi-Agent Defense Against Adversarial Attacks in Energy Forecasting
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: Paper proposes a multi-agent defense against adversarial attacks on time-series LLMs used for electricity-demand forecasting.

item.title: Black-Box Adversarial Example Attacks on Machine Learning based Election Systems
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: Paper studies black-box adversarial example attacks on machine-learning ballot classification in election systems.

item.title: SANAI: Secure ECC Distributed Keyed Parity Embedded in Weights for Protecting Neural Networks against Bit-Flip Attacks
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: SANAI proposes keyed ECC parity embedded in weights to protect quantized neural networks from bit-flip attacks such as RowHammer.

item.title: Beyond Prompt Injection: The Tool Update Gap in LLM Agent Security
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: Paper shows LLM agent frameworks may keep trusting external tools after updates without re-verifying their safety.

item.title: Step-Zero Attack: Agent Safety Before Observability
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: Step-Zero Attack paper shows coding agents can be compromised before content enters model context.

item.title: Enhancing Edge AI System Security with a Stacked Hardware Security Controller for Robust and Energy-Efficient Anomaly Detectio
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: Paper proposes a stacked hardware security controller for Edge AI anomaly detection.

item.title: The Blind Spots of Detection: Adversarial Perturbation Attacks against Watchdogs in Distributed LLM Inference
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: Paper shows adversarial perturbations can evade watchdog verification in distributed LLM inference.

item.title: Illusion: Safeguarding Topology Confidentiality in LLM Multi-Agent Systems via Behavior-Preserving Obfuscation
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: Illusion paper proposes obfuscation to protect communication topology confidentiality in LLM multi-agent systems.

item.title: AgentCap: Capability-Based Runtime Authorization for Secure LLM Agent Execution
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: AgentCap proposes capability-based runtime authorization to limit prompt injection impact on LLM agents.

item.title: The Long Con on the Web: Earn-then-Exploit Fraud Attacks against Coding Agents
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: Paper describes earn-then-exploit web fraud attacks targeting privileged coding agents.

item.title: Adversarial Robustness Is Not Zero-Day Generalization: A Controlled Evaluation of Flow-Based Intrusion Detectors on Corrected CIC-IDS2017
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: Study finds adversarial robustness does not equal zero-day generalization in ML intrusion detectors.

item.title: Threat Modeling Intimate Partner Abuse in Agentic Systems
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: Paper threat-models how agentic AI systems could be abused in intimate partner abuse.

item.title: Kerkoporta: Injecting Structured-Output Backdoors in Reasoning Coding Agents
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: Paper Kerkoporta shows structured-output backdoors can be injected into reasoning coding agents.

item.title: Reino Unido advierte que un ataque de ransomware con IA contra infraestructuras es «altamente probable» para 2028
item.description: TradingView: UK warns that an AI-enabled ransomware attack on infrastructure is 'highly likely' by 2028, per the report.

item.title: 人工智能助朝鲜黑客瞄准高价值加密货币企业
item.description: Mezha.net: Report says AI is helping North Korean hackers target high-value cryptocurrency firms; no specific victim named.

item.title: Хакеры крадут доступ к ИИ и накручивают компаниям счета на $100 тысяч в день
item.description: dev.by: Hackers reportedly steal AI service access and run up bills of about $100,000 a day for companies.

item.title: Montana AG says OpenAI has 90 days to respond as ChatGPT child safety suit advances
item.description: NBC Montana: Montana's attorney general says OpenAI has 90 days to respond as a ChatGPT child-safety suit advances.

item.title: Piratage de la plateforme de cryptomonnaies Binance : la plateforme annonce rouvrir les retraits, le FBI accuse la Corée du Nord du « casse du siècle »
item.description: Le Monde.fr: Binance reopens withdrawals after its hack; the FBI reportedly blames North Korea for the 'heist of the century'.

item.title: ИИ находит дыры быстрее, чем люди успевают их латать: 1411 уязвимостей за один месяц
item.description: Хабр: Habr article reports AI finding 1,411 vulnerabilities in one month, faster than they can be patched.

item.title: Ограбление Binance на сумму более 6 миллиардов долларов: хакеры из КНДР использовали ИИ
item.description: Дзеркало тижня: Report says North Korean hackers used AI in a Binance theft of over $6 billion; this matches an incident already tracked.

item.title: AI malware attacks likely within 2 years: UK cyber cheif
item.description: The News International: UK cyber chief says AI malware attacks are likely within two years.

item.title: Rusia denuncia un ciberataque impulsado por inteligencia artificial que logró infiltrarse en más de 10 servidores en 3 horas.
item.description: Vietnam.vn: Russia reports an AI-driven cyberattack that infiltrated over 10 servers within 3 hours, likely the already-known Russian case.

item.title: FBI警告：期中選舉AI詐騙 假募款、竊個資…幾可亂真
item.description: 世界新聞網: FBI warns of AI-enabled fake fundraising and data-theft scams around the US midterm elections.

item.title: В Британии предупредили о риске кибератак на инфраструктуру с ИИ в ближайшие 2 года
item.description: Report.az: Report says Britain was warned of AI-enabled cyberattack risk to infrastructure within two years; the issuer is not named.

item.title: Россия сообщает о кибератаке с использованием искусственного интеллекта, в результате которой за 3 часа было взломано более 10 серверов.
item.description: Vietnam.vn: Russia reports an AI-assisted cyberattack that compromised more than 10 servers in 3 hours, likely the already-tracked Russian case.

item.title: AI fraud warning as report finds ‘significant’ rise in use of technology by organised criminals
item.description: Irish Independent: A report reportedly finds a significant rise in organised criminals' use of AI for fraud; the issuing body is not named.

item.title: Critical Langflow AI Vulnerabilities Allow Hackers to Execute Remote Code Without Authentication
item.description: GBHackers: IBM discloses seven Langflow OSS flaws, including auth bypass and code injection, in versions 1.0.0 through 1.12.8.

item.title: В Великобритании предупредили о риске кибератак на инфраструктуру с ИИ в ближайшие два года
item.description: MY.UA: UK warning reported of AI-enabled cyberattack risk to infrastructure in the next two years.

item.title: La Russie signale une cyberattaque utilisant l'intelligence artificielle, ayant permis d'infiltrer plus de 10 serveurs en 3 heures.
item.description: Vietnam.vn: Russia reports a cyberattack using AI that infiltrated more than 10 servers in three hours.

item.title: Зачем платить за ИИ, если можно украсть ключ? Хакеры прогнали через чужие модели 2,5 млн запросов
item.description: SecurityLab.ru: Hackers reportedly ran 2.5 million requests through other people's AI models using a stolen API key.

item.title: Hackers Use ARTEX AI to Breach WorkOS and Access Customer Slack Conversations
item.description: CyberSecurityNews: Hackers reportedly used the ARTEX AI framework to breach WorkOS and access customer Slack conversations.

item.title: ИИ-агенты оказались уязвимы перед атаками на маршрутизаторы
item.description: 3DNews: Report says AI agents are vulnerable to attacks on the routers they rely on.
